effects: Exactly `assets` USDT moves from the signer to the vault (safeTransferFrom in enter).
previewDeposit(assets) bbqUSDT shares are minted to onBehalf. The price comes from storage after accrueInterest, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.01 USDT, shares (ticker bbqUSDT) sent to the onBehalf address; the share amount is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown, and the calldata holds no bound for it
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The share price comes from storage. Case 0: signer in 0.01 bbqUSDT (10000000000000000); the screen shows only the ticker 'bbqUSDT'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A wallet could show previewDeposit at signing time.

cases.notes: The USDT out amount and the vault are right. Shares arrive at the signer, who is onBehalf, but the amount is not shown, and the reader said so.

effects: previewMint(shares) USDT (rounded up, from the storage price) moves from the signer to the vault, limited only by the signer's USDT allowance.
Exactly `shares` bbqUSDT are minted to onBehalf.
formats.shown: Mint 0.999999999 bbqUSDT to 0x…dEaD, with a 'Deposit asset: USDT' line but no USDT amount.

findings.title: mint: the USDT pulled from the signer is not shown, and the calldata holds no maximum
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`, then enter: `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: signer out 1.015565 USDT (1015565); the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDT'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A wallet could show previewMint. Steer users to deposit when they need an exact cost.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' / 'Mint {shares} for {onBehalf}' does not say the signer pays USDT
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". USDT leaves the signer (enter: safeTransferFrom from msg.sender). Only a separate raw field 'Deposit asset' = 'USDT' hints at it.
findings.fix: Use intent "Deposit USDT to mint shares" and interpolatedIntent "Pay USDT to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". Label the constant field 'Pay with'.

cases.notes: The signer's only effect is 1.015565 USDT out. The screen names USDT but not the amount, and the reader saw the gap. Shares went to 0xdead (signer null); that is shown right.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: previewWithdraw(assets) bbqUSDT shares (rounded up, from the storage price) are burned from onBehalf.
Exactly `assets` USDT moves from the vault to receiver.
If the signer is not onBehalf, the signer's share allowance from onBehalf drops by the shares burned.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 750000 USDT to the receiver, with the owner whose shares are used shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is not shown, and the calldata holds no maximum
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`, then exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: signer out 747756.664077888408766176 bbqUSDT; the screen shows no share amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A wallet could show previewWithdraw.

cases.notes: The 750000 USDT in to the signer is shown exactly. The shares burned are inferred, but their amount is not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `shares` bbqUSDT are burned from onBehalf. If the signer is not onBehalf, the signer's allowance is spent.
previewRedeem(shares) USDT (from the storage price, no minimum) moves from the vault to receiver.
formats.shown: Redeem 0.5587 bbqUSDT from the owner to the receiver; the asset and amount received are not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is not shown, and the calldata holds no minimum
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(...)`, then exit: `safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. Case 3: signer in 0.558924 USDT; no amount is on the screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A wallet could show previewRedeem.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDT as the asset the receiver gets
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, onBehalf only. The interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}" does not name USDT. Mint uses a constant field `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`. Case 3 reader: 'Whether the underlying asset is really USDT; I'm inferring it from the name'.
findings.fix: Add a field {label: 'Receive asset', value: '$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'} and set interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} for USDT to {#.receiver}".

cases.notes: The shares out are exact. The reader guessed 'likely USDT' for what arrives, with no amount, because the screen names neither.
